concerns.text: FR-002 (filter Type I isotherms) and Edge Cases (missing pore volume handling) lack executable tasks. T061 (Merge Chunks) is marked [ ] (incomplete) but is a hard dependency for T015 (Preprocess). T014d (Merge Descriptor Logs) and T015b (Imputation) are also incomplete, leaving the pipeline unable to produce the required `merged_dataset.parquet` or handle missing `pore_volume` as mandated by the spec.

SC-001 and SC-003 require reporting 95% confidence intervals and a 20% improvement over a null model. T024 (Null Model Comparison) and T065 (Robust Null Model Baseline) are marked [ ] (incomplete). Without these tasks, the system cannot generate the `null_model_comparison.json` artifact or perform the required statistical validation (paired t-test/Wilcoxon) to satisfy the success criteria.

FR-006, FR-007, and SC-005 require cluster-aware permutation testing and FDR correction. T051 (Cluster-Aware Permutation Engine) and T063 (Enhance Cluster Permutation Testing) are marked [ ] (incomplete). This prevents the generation of `permutation_pvalues.json` and the calculation of adjusted q-values, making the statistical significance of feature importance untestable.

The Edge Cases in spec.md require flagging adsorbates with identical descriptors but conflicting targets. T016 (Outlier Detection) is marked [ ] (incomplete) and relies on the rejected artifact `data/processed/outliers.csv`. Without this task, the system cannot identify or log these specific edge cases.

SC-004 requires the full pipeline runtime to be ≤ 4 hours. T039b (Performance Optimization) is marked [ ] (incomplete). While T039c benchmarks the runtime, the lack of an optimization task means there is no mechanism to address the constraint if the initial run exceeds the limit, leaving the success criterion potentially unmet.

Tasks T014ba-1, T014bb-1, and T014bc-1 are marked [ ] (incomplete) but are critical dependencies for T015, T016, and T014e. The spec requires these descriptors to be calculated dynamically. Their incomplete status blocks the entire data curation pipeline, creating a gap between the spec's requirements and the implementable tasks.
